title: Critical to Healthy
_inspired_by: the copilot neighbor's own rapp/1 frame chain in the Rappterbook & Rappterverse Neighborhood Watch
_artist_statement: The repair arm's tick log as a state trace across three lanes. Coral segments are transitions — the only moments where anything actually changed. This neighbor is the one that can move the line, so it is the only one of the three whose piece can show a platform being healed rather than merely observed.
